mechanism.claim: Periodic algorithmic trading concentrates information in the first five minutes of crypto quarter-hours. A completed day in which at least four liquid alt perpetuals share an unusually strong same-direction innovation in quarter-opening flow relative to their own causal daily baselines should transmit to BTC for twelve hours during elevated variation.
mechanism.side: strict majority sign of six alt daily quarter-opening normalized-flow innovations; BTC flow and price direction are never inputs

external_basis.paper: The Quarter-Hour Effect: Periodic Algorithmic Trading and Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Futures
external_basis.reported_result: quarter-hour opening order imbalance is informative for four-to-twelve-hour cryptocurrency futures returns
external_basis.adaptation: aggregate all 96 completed daily opening windows and remove each alt own strictly-prior 30-day median before cross-alt consensus

mechanism.why_distinct: HVCAQF treats each individual quarter-hour raw-flow onset as an event and failed Gross9 proximity. HVDCAFC uses the entire UTC-day raw flow level and failed directional balance. CAFAER uses full-day day-over-day flow acceleration plus BTC confirmation and fades. HVDQOFS uses one daily event from only scheduled opening windows, per-alt causal median innovations, no BTC flow/direction, and no reused event or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC daily variation must occupy its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily phase-restricted cross-alt flow-surprise clock is absent from Gross9

features.opening_minutes: for every quarter-hour Q in [D-24h,D), use exactly five bars_binance one-minute rows [Q,Q+5m); 96 windows and 480 rows per symbol
features.daily_opening_flow: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume)/sum(quote_asset_volume) over only those 480 rows per alt; positive denominator and finite
features.causal_baseline: median daily_opening_flow over 30 exact source-valid calendar days strictly before current day, minimum 24, separately per alt
features.flow_innovation: current daily opening flow minus own causal baseline, finite strict nonzero
features.consensus: at least four of six innovation signs share one direction; 3-3 rejects
features.consensus_strength: median absolute innovation among only direction-confirming alts, finite strict positive
features.strength_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 jointly source-valid days, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.60
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute open-to-close returns over completed day), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 jointly source-valid days, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: D after all opening windows and BTC path complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty
clock.rv20: q90 only after unchanged all-stage pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable-then-adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: paper-supported periodic order flow expressed as causal daily phase-restricted surprise

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, phase, window, aggregation, baseline, innovation, breadth, strength, history, rank, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, source, or control repair
